page.overview:
Who is Combat Ship?

Tony Trihull is a minor character in Cars 2.

Tony is first seen in the beginning of the film, confronting Crabby, who has Finn McMissile aboard him, and telling him to go away. Crabby refuses, but Tony threatens to shoot at him, which forces Crabby to leave. Without Tony knowing, Finn hitches a ride on him and they both arrive at a huge oil platform. Sometime later, Tony, now with Acer aboard, chases Finn, along with another combat ship that has Grem aboard, out of the oil platform and in the middle of the ocean, before firing a torpedo at him and, unbeknownst to the Lemons, missing. He makes a very brief appearance in Tokyo, docked next to the Lemons' other combat ship, near a warehouse where Rod "Torque" Redline was being held captive by the Lemons. He is later seen in Tokyo in the abandoned barracks, where the lemons killed Rod "Torque" Redline. He is given another scene towards the end of the movie in London, when Professor Z is trying to escape, yelling for the Professor to hurry and get aboard him. Finn manages to use his grappling hooks on the Professor, forcing Tony to use a giant magnet in order to pull the Professor to him. Finn then deploys multiple magnetic explosives from his axles, which cling onto Tony's magnet, resulting in a huge explosion that ends up killing him.
